PyInstaller Bootloader Exception

PyInstaller is licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or
later, with a special exception for distributing bundled applications.

The exception states that distributing the bootloader together with other
files to form a larger work does not by itself cause the resulting larger
work to be covered by the GNU General Public License. The exception does not
override the license of any other bundled component.

The complete and current PyInstaller license text is maintained at:
https://pyinstaller.org/en/stable/license.html

PyInstaller source code is available at:
https://github.com/pyinstaller/pyinstaller
